product_metadata.title: Kitchen + Home Food Safety Holder for Any Mandolin Slicer or Grater
features: QUICK & EASY - Cut your prep time in half! Our food safety holder makes perfect cuts quickly, safely and easily.
SAFETY - Plastic food holder keeps fingers safe during slicing and adds extra stability.
SECURE GRIP - Prongs hold food securely while top button is pressed and allows the entire length of the food item to be sliced.
VERSATILE - Fits any size vegetable or fruit, hard cheeses and meats. Works on any mandolin slicer or grater.
DISHWASHER SAFE - Easily clean with warm water or top rack dishwasher safe. Measures 6” x 6” x 2.5” inches.
description: This handy Kitchen + Home food holder keeps fingers and knuckles away from sharp blades on slicers and graters. When gentle pressure with a thumb or finger is applied to the top button, prongs on the holder secure any size fruit or vegetable, or piece of hard cheese or meat, and allow the entire length of the food item to be sliced. The food holder works well with any mandolin slicer or any cheese grater products. Easily clean with warm water or top rack dishwasher safe. Measures 6” x 6” x 2.5” inches.
